Range 60 feet

Targets 1 creature

Duration 10 minutes

The target is marked with your patron's sigil, with no save. You and any ally who can see the sigil gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls and to Rite spell attack rolls against the marked creature. You always know the direction and rough distance to a creature carrying your sigil, even out of sight. Only one creature may carry your sigil at a time.
